The remaining 22 forced targets remain UNKNOWN_WITH_REASON[UPSTREAM_ADMISSIBILITY_RECEIPT_MISSING]. The shared defect was returned upstream once as ggen-marketplace PR317, exact base 9eb077b3f2f0486fe1a434b0f00cfe473cabc98a, head e00541af68f879500aac0c28d197f5a84092c746, pack packs/forced-top25-admissibility-factory-pack. No new realized downstream fanout is claimed until generated projections are committed and qualified in external consumer repos.
